title: Small Is Not Dead: Distance-Aware Cluster Revival for e-means
abstract: arXiv:2611.18238v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: e-means (Bessa et al., 2026) is a recent mini-batch k-means algorithm, now part of the FAISS library, that reaches the error of Lloyd's algorithm about an order of magnitude faster on large embedding datasets. Every five mini-batches, it removes every cluster whose running point count falls below a tenth of the average and reuses its centre to split a large cluster. In the authors' ablation, removing this mechanism, called dead-cluster revival, raises the error more than removing any other component added to the moving-average update. The rule, however, considers only cluster size: it cannot distinguish a cluster that is small because it is redundant from one that covers a rare, isolated group of points, and on data with such groups it repeatedly removes centres whose removal is costly. translated_title: 小并非消亡：面向 e-means 的距离感知聚类复活机制
translated_abstract: e-means（Bessa 等人，2026）是一种新近提出的小批量 k-means 算法，现已并入 FAISS 库，在大规模嵌入数据集上能比 Lloyd 算法快约一个数量级地达到相同的误差水平。每处理五个小批量，该算法会移除所有运行中点数低于平均值十分之一的聚类，并将其中心重新用于分裂一个大聚类。在作者的消融实验中，移除这一被称为“死聚类复活”的机制所导致的误差上升，比移除滑动平均更新中加入的其他任何组件都要大。然而，该规则仅考虑聚类规模：它无法区分因冗余而变小，还是因覆盖稀疏、孤立的点群而变小，因此在包含此类点群的数据上，它会反复移除那些移除代价很高的中心。我们增加了一个基于中心间距离的第二条件：仅当小聚类的中心相对于彼此靠近另一个中心时，小聚类才会被移除。
tldr: 针对 e-means 仅依据聚类规模判定死聚类、会误删覆盖稀疏孤立点群的小聚类的问题，本文提出增加基于中心间距离的第二条件——只有当小聚类的中心靠近其他中心时才将其移除复活，从而在含稀疏孤立点群的数据上显著降低聚类误差。
en_tdlr: This paper improves e-means' dead-cluster revival by adding a distance-based second condition, removing a small cluster only when its centre is close to another centre, thereby preserving clusters that cover rare, isolated groups of points and reducing clustering error.
